---
title: "An exploration of prompts given these personas and questions"
---

```{python}
from SurveyResponder import SurveyResponder

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

from IPython.display import display, Markdown

# While building and testing we'll use just 2 responses
num_responses = 2

responder = SurveyResponder(
    questions_path="dass21questions.json",
    persona_path="persona_dass21_final.json",
    model_name="olmo2:7b",
    num_responses=num_responses,
    temperature=0.8,
    base_url="http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
)

for i in range(4):
    display(Markdown(f"***\n\n## Persona Example\n\n***"))
    display(Markdown(responder.example_persona()))
    display(Markdown("***"))

```

# Prompts... ...

```{python}
for i in range(4):
